title: Zesty Vietnamese Chicken Noodles
description: A rich and flavorful Vietnamese dish featuring chicken, noodles, and rocket, perfect for a solo dinner, this recipe is high in protein and can be prepared in under 30 minutes.
instructions: Heat the vegetable oil in a large skillet or wok over medium high heat.
Add the chicken to the skillet and cook until browned and cooked through, about 5 minutes.
Remove the chicken from the skillet and set aside.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger to the skillet and cook for 1 minute.
Add the rice noodles to the skillet and cook for 2 minutes, stirring constantly.
Add the rocket leaves to the skillet and cook until wilted, about 2 minutes.
In a small bowl, whisk together the fish sauce, lime juice, salt, and black pepper.
Pour the sauce over the noodles and chicken, and stir to combine.
Return the chicken to the skillet and stir to combine with the noodles and sauce.
Cook for an additional 1 minute, until the chicken is coated in the sauce.
